## Problem
The .bridge_state/projects.json write path is a HAND-ROLLED client that bypasses the
authoritative shared store seams and thereby violates the tickets-branch invariant
(every mutation runs under the unified write lock AND auto-commits+publishes).
projects_store._write_record hand-rolls tempfile+os.replace instead of the shared
fsutil.atomic_write, and projects_store.set_project/remove_project never commit or push
(no lock, no publish). This forced the ad-hoc hand-commits behind incident
05b8-4efe-8d58-4c27 (LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO leak).

## Scope: CONVERT the hand-rolled client to the authoritative shared seams ONLY
Reuse the existing seams exactly as-is. Do NOT modify the seams and do NOT build a facade
over them (that would be additional, separately-approved scope):
- rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write — the shared crash-atomic file write.
- rebar._store.push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch(tracker, *, message=...) — commits all
  pending tracker changes UNDER THE WRITE LOCK (+ rebase guard) then pushes.

## Approach (pure conversion)
1. projects_store._write_record: replace the hand-rolled mkstemp/os.replace with a call to
   fsutil.atomic_write. Behavior-preserving: prove the on-disk bytes are byte-identical
   (json.dump indent=2, sort_keys=True + trailing "\n").
2. After a mapping mutation, publish via the existing seam: call
   push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch(tracker, message="bridge: update projects mapping")
   from the mutation entry point (projects_store mutators or their _lib_ops callers) so
   set_project/remove_project are durable + published under the write lock with no ad-hoc
   git. Read path untouched.
3. Record the invariant (explicitly requested): add the two-part invariant to
   docs/concurrency.md "Mutating the tracker" section — EVERY tickets-branch mutation runs
   under write_lock AND auto-commits+publishes.

## Explicitly OUT of scope (separate tickets)
- Write-time project-key VALIDATION — separate ticket (a distinct behavior addition, not a
  seam conversion).
- Any change to resolve_project / legacy_default (ticket a011).
- Any modification of the shared seam or a new facade over it (needs separate approval).

## Acceptance criteria
1. projects_store uses fsutil.atomic_write; serialized bytes unchanged (pinned test).
2. A projects.json mutation is committed + pushed under the write lock via
   commit_and_push_tickets_branch (patch the seam; assert invoked) — no ad-hoc git.
3. docs/concurrency.md states the two-part invariant.
4. No new commit/push/lock/atomic-write helper is introduced; the seams are used as-is.

## Test plan
- RED unit pinning projects.json serialized bytes across the atomic_write swap.
- Unit asserting a mapping mutation calls push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch(tracker, ...)
  — the invariant regression guard.

## Sequencing
Edits projects_store.py + docs/concurrency.md (+ tests); reuses push/fsutil (no edit).
Disjoint from A/C/D. Ticket F (key validation) and ticket E (parity conversion) both edit
projects_store.py / the reconciler commit path and are sequenced AFTER this one.
